en_title: Zach Cregger Says He's Done With Franchise Films After Resident Evil
cn_title: 《生化危机》导演称不再拍系列片
subtitle: 只拍这一部
opus_summary: 《生化危机》电影导演Zach Cregger称，今后不会再主导其他IP改编的系列电影。他接手本片是因热爱游戏，也已有续作想法。影片预计2026年9月18日上映。

paragraphs.en: Resident Evil movie director Zach Cregger is days away from his survival horror adaptation's theatrical premiere, but don't expect to help bring another franchise film to the big screen ever again.
paragraphs.cn: Zach Cregger执导的《生化危机》生存恐怖改编电影再过几天便将公映，但别指望他今后还会再参与其他系列电影的制作。

paragraphs.en: The filmmaker behind this month's Capcom project talked about what's next for him during a conversation with Deadline . When asked if he's ever been pressured to spearhead another recognizable IP, he gave a blunt answer: "I'm not doing that."
paragraphs.cn: 执导本月上映的卡普空作品《生化危机》的Cregger，在与Deadline的访谈中谈及接下来的计划。有人问他是否曾被施压，要求他主导其他知名IP改编作品；他的回答很干脆：「我不会这么做。」

paragraphs.en: "I have never been approached by another franchise," Cregger said. "Maybe I have, but it would never get to me because I have been very clear that I’m not doing that. I’m doing this, and that’s it for me."
paragraphs.cn: Cregger说：「我从未收到其他系列作品的邀约。也许有人找过我，但那也不会传到我这里，因为我早就明确表示过，我不会这么做。我只会做这部，就到此为止。」

paragraphs.en: One might suspect Cregger's aversion to big franchise films like Resident Evil might stem from the backlash he's received in the months leading up to his movie's premiere. While the Barbarian and Weapons creator certainly has plenty of defenders looking forward to seeing his new live-action take, there have been many, many others who aren't quite as excited.
paragraphs.cn: 或许有人会猜测，Cregger抗拒《生化危机》这类大型系列电影，是源于影片上映前几个月遭遇的反弹。尽管《野蛮人》和《凶器》的创作者确实拥有许多支持者，期待看到他对《生化危机》的全新真人诠释，但也有非常多的人并不那么兴奋。

paragraphs.en: Most of the pressure has come from those who feel his Resident Evil doesn't align with the game it's based on. Changes to the source material, including its modern setting and snowy Raccoon City , have set fans on edge, while others aren't in love with the idea of following a new protagonist (Austin Abrams' Bryan Hodukavich) instead of someone like Leon S. Kennedy or Claire Redfield.
paragraphs.cn: 多数压力来自认为这版《生化危机》不符合其改编所依据游戏的人。影片对原作作出的改动，例如将故事设在现代，并呈现一座白雪皑皑的浣熊市，已经让粉丝紧张不安。另一些人则不喜欢故事跟随新主角——Austin Abrams饰演的Bryan Hodukavich——而非里昂·S·肯尼迪或克莱尔·雷德菲尔德等角色。

paragraphs.en: The controversy surrounding the Resident Evil movie has been quite loud , but there are several factors at play when it comes to his plans for the future. He clarified that the decision comes down to his status as a writer who wants "to write whatever I want to write."
paragraphs.cn: 围绕这部《生化危机》电影的争议确实闹得很大，但谈及未来计划时，还牵涉到其他几个因素。他解释说，作出这个决定，归根结底是因为他是个想「写任何自己想写的东西」的编剧。

paragraphs.en: "I don’t want to write something where I have to make sure I'm tagging different data points to satisfy X," he continued. "I just want to satisfy me. And the only reason that I think Resident Evil is OK for me to do is because I’m enthusiastic about the games and I like the story that I thought of with the games and I’m making it for me. I think this movie is cool, and I hope it checks the fan boxes because I’m a fan and I’m checking my boxes.
paragraphs.cn: 他继续说：「我不想写那种得确保自己在各种数据指标上都打了勾、以满足X的东西。我只想让自己满意。我觉得自己能拍《生化危机》的唯一原因，是我热爱这些游戏，也喜欢自己基于它们构思出的故事；而且，我是在为自己拍这部电影。我觉得这部电影很酷，也希望它能满足粉丝的期待，因为我也是粉丝，我也在满足自己作为粉丝的期待。」

paragraphs.en: "I'm making the Resident Evil movie that I wish existed, so I can do that with a clean heart and a clear conscience and not feel like I’m getting f**ked by some weird industry thing."
paragraphs.cn: 「我正在拍一部我希望存在的《生化危机》电影，因此可以坦坦荡荡、问心无愧地去做，不必觉得自己被行业里某件莫名其妙的事坑了。」

paragraphs.en: Cregger has made it abundantly clear that his Resident Evil movie is meant to be a love letter to the experience of playing games like Resident Evil 4 and Resident Evil 7. Although he's writing off franchise films in the future, it sounds like another trip to Raccoon City – or maybe even somewhere else in the Resident Evil universe – isn't out of the question yet. In another recent interview, the director said he already has "ideas" for a sequel , even if we have yet to see how audiences will respond to the first movie.
paragraphs.cn: Cregger已反复强调，他的《生化危机》电影是一封献给游玩《生化危机4》《生化危机7》等游戏这一体验的情书。尽管他已排除未来拍摄系列电影的可能，但似乎尚未排除再次回到浣熊市，或前往《生化危机》宇宙其他地方的可能。他最近在另一场采访中说，自己已有续作的「想法」，尽管观众会如何回应首部电影仍未可知。

paragraphs.en: Resident Evil is expected to have a big debut when it slithers into theaters September 18, 2026. Next up on his schedule are projects like the Siren Head movie , The Flood , and a Weapons prequel movie . While we wait to see Cregger's new vision for Raccoon City, you can check out a new trailer that revealed a sneak peek at a creature that looks suspiciously like RE4's Las Plagas . You can also check out its organ transplant bag-inspired popcorn bucket .
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机》预计将于2026年9月18日登陆院线，并有望取得强势开局。Cregger接下来计划推进的项目包括《Siren Head》电影、《The Flood》以及《凶器》前传电影。在等待他对浣熊市的新诠释之际，不妨看看一支新预告片，片中抢先展示了一只看上去很像《生化危机4》中Las Plagas的生物。还可以看看该片以器官移植袋为灵感打造的爆米花桶。
